lines.text: A research team went silent on the north glacier. I'm going to look. Don't follow.

lines.speaker: RANGER KEST
lines.text: A Nexus captain asked for a route over the pass. I gave her the honest one. She thanked me for the honesty.

lines.speaker: RANGER KEST
lines.text: Cities and their masks. Up here the storm's the only mask and it fits everyone.

lines.speaker: RANGER KEST
lines.text: The crown's log named your companion. The crew remembers it. Older than the storm.

lines.speaker: RANGER KEST
lines.text: The glacier's still. Properly still. First time since the sky. I don't trust it. I'm enjoying it.

lines.speaker: ANYA VOLKOVA
lines.text: I was in the terminal when it hit. The snow outside turned violet. I took a photo. I don't look at it.

lines.speaker: ANYA VOLKOVA
lines.text: The Fracture delayed my flight by a year. I stopped counting. I started walking.

lines.speaker: ANYA VOLKOVA
lines.text: Frostveil terminal. My flight's delayed. It's been delayed three times. I've made friends with the chairs.

lines.speaker: ANYA VOLKOVA
lines.text: The lights in the ice are beautiful. That worries me. Beautiful things up here usually want something.

lines.speaker: ANYA VOLKOVA
lines.text: Are you… from the airline? No? Oh. Okay.

lines.speaker: ANYA VOLKOVA
lines.text: Oh! It's you! You came back from the caverns. Everyone said nobody does.

lines.speaker: ANYA VOLKOVA
lines.text: You're the only person in this terminal who isn't waiting for something. It's… calming.

lines.speaker: ANYA VOLKOVA
lines.text: If my flight ever leaves, I'm not going. I decided. Don't ask why. You know why.

lines.speaker: ANYA VOLKOVA
lines.text: The ranger went up the north glacier alone. The whole terminal's pretending not to watch the door.

lines.speaker: ANYA VOLKOVA
lines.text: A Nexus captain came through on a transport. She looked at the ice and didn't flinch. Everyone flinches.

lines.speaker: ANYA VOLKOVA
lines.text: Surface news on the terminal screens. Masks. Crowds. It looks warm, at least.

lines.speaker: ANYA VOLKOVA
lines.text: The ice sang when the crown came down. The glaciologist cried. I cried too. Don't tell him.

lines.speaker: ANYA VOLKOVA
lines.text: My flight's boarding. Actually boarding. I'm not getting on. I'm staying. Hi.

lines.speaker: LARS HOLM
lines.text: The ice is singing at a frequency it shouldn't. Started the day the sky cracked. I've recorded every note.

lines.speaker: LARS HOLM
lines.text: Forty years studying glaciers. These ones are studying me back. The Fracture introduced us.

lines.speaker: LARS HOLM
lines.text: Frostveil research, the terminal lab. Ice cores, seismographs, a kettle that's older than the station.

lines.speaker: LARS HOLM
lines.text: The summit array's a machine. Was a machine. Is a machine again. I've stopped using tenses.

lines.speaker: LARS HOLM
lines.text: Don't touch the cores. Don't breathe on the cores. Stand… there.

lines.speaker: LARS HOLM
lines.text: The operator! The ice changed key when you arrived. I have it on tape.

lines.speaker: LARS HOLM
lines.text: You're the only one who listens to the recordings all the way through. All forty hours. Twice.

lines.speaker: LARS HOLM
lines.text: I've named a frequency after you. It's the one the ice sings when it's calm. Don't be modest; it's science.

lines.speaker: LARS HOLM
lines.text: The north glacier's singing a distress call. Eighteen seconds, looping. I've sent the ranger.

lines.speaker: LARS HOLM
lines.text: A Nexus captain asked for my data. All of it. I gave it. Someone should have it who'll act.

lines.speaker: LARS HOLM
lines.text: The cities and their masks. The ice has no face. I find that restful.

lines.speaker: LARS HOLM
lines.text: The crown's log: nineteen years of memory. One of them belongs to your companion. I've archived it. Respectfully.

lines.speaker: LARS HOLM
lines.text: The ice is singing in tune. Calm, slow, low. I've recorded it. I'll play it at my funeral. Not soon.

lines.speaker: MARSHAL DRAEV
lines.text: The war ended the week before the sky cracked. The Fracture reopened every grave. I have been closing them since.

lines.speaker: MARSHAL DRAEV
lines.text: The Fracture is a wound in a land built from wounds. We know how to dress it. Slowly.

lines.speaker: MARSHAL DRAEV
lines.text: Obsidian Reach. Every ridge is a battlefield nobody cleared. My people live between the craters.

lines.speaker: MARSHAL DRAEV
lines.text: The Ash Outpost. The line. Everything past it was somebody's and is now the Reach's.

lines.speaker: MARSHAL DRAEV
lines.text: Not all disagreements survive the first shot.

lines.speaker: MARSHAL DRAEV
lines.text: You held fire on the ones who ran. Most hear that as a suggestion.

lines.speaker: MARSHAL DRAEV
lines.text: Now you ask the right question. Keep asking it.

lines.speaker: MARSHAL DRAEV
lines.text: Peace is a discipline, not a holiday. You keep it. So do we. The Accord stands.

lines.speaker: MARSHAL DRAEV
lines.text: Raiders from the wastes, armed with Syndicate money. The ruins will burn unless someone stands.

lines.speaker: MARSHAL DRAEV
lines.text: The Nexus captain and I have spoken. She counts her people. I respect anyone who counts.

lines.speaker: MARSHAL DRAEV
lines.text: Masks in the Nexus plaza. Here we have no masks. We know every face. That is worse and better.

lines.speaker: MARSHAL DRAEV
lines.text: Your companion's origin is known to the Reach. We fought beside its makers once. We do not speak of it.

lines.speaker: MARSHAL DRAEV
lines.text: The ridges are quiet. The craters are being filled. My people are planting. Planting.

lines.speaker: CORPORAL RUTH MBEKI
lines.text: I was on the line when it hit. The old battlefield lit up. Every crater. I've never seen the dead so bright.

lines.speaker: CORPORAL RUTH MBEKI
lines.text: The Fracture made the night louder. The battlefields hum. You learn to sleep through it. You don't.

lines.speaker: CORPORAL RUTH MBEKI
lines.text: The Ash Outpost. The marshal's line. Stay inside the lights after dark; the craters get ideas.

lines.speaker: CORPORAL RUTH MBEKI
lines.text: Every crater out there has a name. We say them at the gate at dusk. All of them.

lines.speaker: CORPORAL RUTH MBEKI
lines.text: Inside the lights. Now.

lines.speaker: CORPORAL RUTH MBEKI
lines.text: The one who held the left flank at the ruins. Fine work. Don't let it go to your head.

lines.speaker: CORPORAL RUTH MBEKI
lines.text: You're the only outsider the marshal's let past the line twice. Don't waste it.

lines.speaker: CORPORAL RUTH MBEKI
lines.text: If the line ever breaks, I want you on it. That's the highest thing I say to anyone.

lines.speaker: CORPORAL RUTH MBEKI
lines.text: Raiders probing the ruins every night. Syndicate weapons. Someone's paying for a war.

lines.speaker: CORPORAL RUTH MBEKI
lines.text: The Nexus captain's people drilled with us. They're soft. They're learning. Fast.

lines.speaker: CORPORAL RUTH MBEKI
lines.text: Masks in the cities. Here you take your helmet off at the gate so we see your face. No exceptions.

lines.speaker: CORPORAL RUTH MBEKI
lines.text: Your companion's makers fought here once. The marshal won't say more. I've stopped asking.

lines.speaker: CORPORAL RUTH MBEKI
lines.text: A night without the hum. A whole night. I slept. I dreamed of nothing. It was perfect.

lines.speaker: GUS VARGA
lines.text: Twelve hours down the shaft when it hit. The obsidian glowed. Foreman said don't look. I looked. I'm fine. Mostly.

lines.speaker: GUS VARGA
lines.text: The Fracture made the deep veins sing. We mine quieter now. Out of respect. Out of fear. Same thing.

lines.speaker: GUS VARGA
lines.text: The obsidian mines, past the outpost. Twelve-hour shifts, gloves that last a day, veins that glow.

lines.speaker: GUS VARGA
lines.text: The ancient forge is down there somewhere. We don't dig toward it. We don't dig away from it either.

lines.speaker: GUS VARGA
lines.text: Mind the edge. Obsidian cuts gloves like paper. Skin like nothing.

lines.speaker: GUS VARGA
lines.text: The operator. You went down the shaft and came back up. Not everyone does.

lines.speaker: GUS VARGA
lines.text: You're the only one who's asked what the veins sound like. I'll show you. Bring gloves.

lines.speaker: GUS VARGA
lines.text: There's a piece of the deep vein in my locker. It's yours. It's warm. It's always warm.

lines.speaker: GUS VARGA
lines.text: The deep veins are glowing brighter. Foreman says don't look. We're all looking.

lines.speaker: GUS VARGA
lines.text: The Nexus captain wants obsidian for armour. Good armour. Bad for gloves.

lines.speaker: GUS VARGA
lines.text: Masks in the cities. Down the shaft we wear masks for the dust. Different thing. Same face underneath.

lines.speaker: GUS VARGA
lines.text: The forge woke when the Nexus lab opened. Across the continent. Your companion's in the song. The veins said so.

lines.speaker: GUS VARGA
lines.text: The veins are glowing soft. Steady. Safe to look. First time. I looked for an hour.

lines.speaker: KIRI TANE
lines.text: Every cargo scale on the dock read zero the second it hit. Everything weightless. Then everything heavy. I lost a crate to the sea.

lines.speaker: KIRI TANE
lines.text: The Fracture made the eastern seam. The seam makes crosswinds. The crosswinds make my job interesting.

lines.speaker: KIRI TANE
lines.text: Azure Isles cargo dock. Seaplanes for the hops, big jets for the mainland. Nothing flies free.

lines.speaker: KIRI TANE
lines.text: The sky dock's past the signal spire. Don't go near the spire. It's listening.

lines.speaker: KIRI TANE
lines.text: Cargo? No cargo, no dock. Rules.

lines.speaker: KIRI TANE
lines.text: The one who held the sky dock. Neri still swears about it. Fondly.

lines.speaker: KIRI TANE
lines.text: You're the only passenger who's helped unload. I've decided that's worth a seat.

lines.speaker: KIRI TANE
lines.text: Any flight, any hop, you're cargo-rated. That's a joke. It's also true.

lines.speaker: KIRI TANE
lines.text: The seam's wider. Crosswinds doubled. Two hops cancelled. Hope's not cargo but it's getting heavy.

lines.speaker: KIRI TANE
lines.text: The Nexus captain wants a supply route to the mainland. I've got the planes. She's got the nerve.

lines.speaker: KIRI TANE
lines.text: Mainland's got masks and crowds. The Isles have wind and fish. Fish are leaving. That's our news.

lines.speaker: KIRI TANE
lines.text: The spire's log named your companion. The spire's been quiet since. I don't trust quiet spires.

lines.speaker: KIRI TANE
lines.text: Seam's closed. Crosswinds gone. The fish came back. The resorts are full. I've got no complaints and it's unsettling.

lines.speaker: LEILANI KAHALE
lines.text: The resort pool went purple. The guests kept swimming. I handed out towels. That's hospitality.

lines.speaker: LEILANI KAHALE
lines.text: The Fracture made the sunsets better. I'm not supposed to say that. The guests say it for me.

lines.speaker: LEILANI KAHALE
lines.text: Welcome to the Isles! Shuttles to every resort from the kerb. Sunset cruise at six. Bring a jacket.

lines.speaker: LEILANI KAHALE
lines.text: The sky dock's the only ugly thing on the island and we've made it a viewpoint.

lines.speaker: LEILANI KAHALE
lines.text: Welcome! Are you… checking in? No? Still welcome!

lines.speaker: LEILANI KAHALE
lines.text: The operator! You held the sky dock. Neri told everyone. Loudly.

lines.speaker: LEILANI KAHALE
lines.text: You're the only guest who tips the shuttle driver. He's named a route after you.

lines.speaker: LEILANI KAHALE
lines.text: The sunset cruise? Yours. Any night. I'll be at the rail. Don't make it a thing.

lines.speaker: LEILANI KAHALE
lines.text: The resorts are full. The fish are leaving. The guests haven't noticed. I have.

lines.speaker: LEILANI KAHALE
lines.text: A Nexus captain booked a room. Didn't use the pool. Used the viewpoint. Twice.

lines.speaker: LEILANI KAHALE
lines.text: Mainland news: masks. We did a masked gala. Then we heard the news. We un-masked.

lines.speaker: LEILANI KAHALE
lines.text: The spire went quiet. The whole island exhaled. Something about your companion. Neri knows.

lines.speaker: LEILANI KAHALE
lines.text: Full resorts, calm seam, fish back. Best season. I'm taking a day off. A whole day.

lines.speaker: SOL NAVARRO
lines.text: I was out past the reef when the sky cracked. The fish stopped. All of them. Hung there. Then they ran.

lines.speaker: SOL NAVARRO
lines.text: Forty years on these waters. The Fracture's the only thing that ever made them swim in circles.

lines.speaker: SOL NAVARRO
lines.text: Azure Isles, the fishing dock. My boat's the blue one. The paint's older than the resort.

lines.speaker: SOL NAVARRO
lines.text: Past the reef's the seam. Don't fish there. The fish don't.

lines.speaker: SOL NAVARRO
lines.text: Mind the nets.

lines.speaker: SOL NAVARRO
lines.text: The one from the sky dock. You can tie a knot. I saw. Rare.

lines.speaker: SOL NAVARRO
lines.text: You're the only one who comes to the dock just to sit. I like that. The sea likes that.

lines.speaker: SOL NAVARRO
lines.text: Dawn, any morning. The blue boat. We'll go past the reef. I've never taken anyone past the reef.

lines.speaker: SOL NAVARRO
lines.text: Fish are swimming in circles. Never seen it. Forty years.

lines.speaker: SOL NAVARRO
lines.text: The Nexus captain bought my whole catch. For a district. Paid fair. Nobody pays fair.

lines.speaker: SOL NAVARRO
lines.text: Mainland's got masks. The sea doesn't care what's on your face. Only what's in your net.

lines.speaker: SOL NAVARRO
lines.text: The spire went quiet and the fish came back. Same hour. Your companion did that. Don't ask me how I know.

lines.speaker: SOL NAVARRO
lines.text: Nets full. Sea calm. Seam closed. I'm an old man and I'm happy. Write that down.

lines.speaker: THE WANDERER
lines.text: The Fracture did not break the world. It woke it. The world has been answering ever since.

lines.speaker: THE WANDERER
lines.text: I walked this coast before the sky cracked. The road remembered me. Now it remembers you.

lines.speaker: THE WANDERER
lines.text: The Shattered Reefs. The drift, the vault, the spire, the deep. Eighteen things live here that are not on any map.

lines.speaker: THE WANDERER
lines.text: This coast. Nothing marked. Everything watched.

lines.speaker: THE WANDERER
lines.text: You cannot force a legend to notice you.

lines.speaker: THE WANDERER
lines.text: The road remembers every traveler. It has started remembering you.

lines.speaker: THE WANDERER
lines.text: The world has begun answering your actions. Listen to what it says.

lines.speaker: THE WANDERER
lines.text: Some doors open for strength. Others for restraint. You have learned both. Few do.

lines.speaker: THE WANDERER
lines.text: An expedition came back with one more member than it left with. Nobody asked who.

lines.speaker: THE WANDERER
lines.text: A captain from the cities walked the drift. She marked nothing. I was surprised.

lines.speaker: THE WANDERER
lines.text: The cities wear masks. The reefs wear tide. The tide is older.

lines.speaker: THE WANDERER
lines.text: Your companion was built to find a host. It found a person instead. The world noticed that before you did.

lines.speaker: THE WANDERER
lines.text: The eighteen are quiet. Watching. The world is still answering. Keep walking.

lines.speaker: BRANN HALE
lines.text: I was leading a group through the canyons when it hit. The crystals rang. Two people turned back. I didn't.

lines.speaker: BRANN HALE
lines.text: The Fracture made the badlands honest. The crystals ring when somebody lies near them. Try it.

lines.speaker: BRANN HALE
lines.text: Crystal Badlands expedition post. Reinforced strip, reinforced boots, reinforced nerves. All three.

lines.speaker: BRANN HALE
lines.text: Nobody goes past the rifts without me. Nobody comes back past them without me either.

lines.speaker: BRANN HALE
lines.text: Boots. Nerves. Show me both.

lines.speaker: BRANN HALE
lines.text: The operator. You crossed the prism fields. Alone. I'm annoyed and impressed.

lines.speaker: BRANN HALE
lines.text: You're the only one who's come back from the rifts with the same number of people. Including you.

lines.speaker: BRANN HALE
lines.text: The deep canyon. Nobody's been. I'll take you. We'll be the first. Or the last. Either's fine.

lines.speaker: BRANN HALE
lines.text: Something in the rifts has come up to look. It's not hostile. It's attentive. That's worse.

lines.speaker: BRANN HALE
lines.text: A Nexus captain asked for a crossing. I said the crystals would ring if she lied. She didn't blink.

lines.speaker: BRANN HALE
lines.text: Cities and masks. Try wearing a mask near a crystal. It rings for an hour.

lines.speaker: BRANN HALE
lines.text: The crystals rang when the Nexus lab opened. Every one. Your companion's name is in the ringing.

lines.speaker: BRANN HALE
lines.text: The rifts are calm. The crystals ring low. The badlands have decided you're honest. Don't disappoint them.

lines.speaker: INES MOREAU
lines.text: My readings went off every scale the second it hit. I've had to invent new scales. Three of them.

lines.speaker: INES MOREAU
lines.text: The Fracture gave me a specimen case I'm not allowed to open. I'm not allowed. I open it. Don't tell.

lines.speaker: INES MOREAU
lines.text: The rift research post, Crystal Badlands. Please don't touch the specimen case. Please.

lines.speaker: INES MOREAU
lines.text: The spire's a mile that way. It's the cleanest signal in the world and I can't read it.

lines.speaker: INES MOREAU
lines.text: D-don't touch that. Or that. Or… just stand still, please.

lines.speaker: INES MOREAU
lines.text: Oh! The operator! The readings spiked when you came in. Good spike. I think.

lines.speaker: INES MOREAU
lines.text: You're the only one who asks what the numbers mean instead of whether they're dangerous. They're both.

lines.speaker: INES MOREAU
lines.text: The specimen case. I'll show you what's in it. I've never shown anyone. It… it's beautiful. And it knows your name.

lines.speaker: INES MOREAU
lines.text: The rifts are reading higher every night. Something's coming up to look. I'm not sleeping.

lines.speaker: INES MOREAU
lines.text: A Nexus captain asked for my data. I gave her the third scale. She understood it. Nobody understands the third scale.

lines.speaker: INES MOREAU
lines.text: Masks in the cities. The crystals would ring at a mask. That's… actually that's a good experiment.

lines.speaker: INES MOREAU
lines.text: The readings have a signature now. NOVA's. Pre-Fracture. I've known for a week. I'm sorry I didn't say.

lines.speaker: INES MOREAU
lines.text: The readings are flat. Calm. I've invented a fourth scale for calm. It's my favourite.

lines.speaker: WARDEN ILYA
lines.text: The forest screamed the day the sky cracked. Every tree. I have not stopped hearing it.

lines.speaker: WARDEN ILYA
lines.text: The Fracture woke the roots. They have been moving since. We walk where they allow.

lines.speaker: WARDEN ILYA
lines.text: The grotto. The Warden's camp. The forest around it listens, so speak the truth or speak softly.

lines.speaker: WARDEN ILYA
lines.text: The living roots lead to what was taken. Follow them. Do not force them.

lines.speaker: WARDEN ILYA
lines.text: The forest will not forgive another invasion. Nor will I.

lines.speaker: WARDEN ILYA
lines.text: Answers have a cost. You have paid one. There will be others.

lines.speaker: WARDEN ILYA
lines.text: Then you have an ally here. The forest has heard me say it.

lines.speaker: WARDEN ILYA
lines.text: I hold you to every word. Gladly. The forest holds you too; that is rarer.

lines.speaker: WARDEN ILYA
lines.text: Outsiders took the heartwood. The trees took the outsiders. It is not finished.

lines.speaker: WARDEN ILYA
lines.text: A captain from Nexus walked the grove. She stayed on the moss. The forest let her.

lines.speaker: WARDEN ILYA
lines.text: The cities wear masks. The forest sees roots, not faces. It is not fooled.

lines.speaker: WARDEN ILYA
lines.text: Your companion's makers sought a host in this forest once. The forest refused them. It did not refuse you.

lines.speaker: WARDEN ILYA
lines.text: The forest is growing over the scars. Slowly. It remembers. It also forgives, slowly.

lines.speaker: SCOUT MIRA
lines.text: I was in the canopy when it hit. The trees swayed with no wind. They've been swaying since. Softly.

lines.speaker: SCOUT MIRA
lines.text: The Fracture made the paths change by dawn. I stopped marking them. I started remembering.

lines.speaker: SCOUT MIRA
lines.text: The north grove. The elder tree, the falls, the grotto. I know the paths today. Tomorrow I'll learn them again.

lines.speaker: SCOUT MIRA
lines.text: Stay on the moss. The forest keeps count of what you break.

lines.speaker: SCOUT MIRA
lines.text: That is how it catches you off guard.

lines.speaker: SCOUT MIRA
lines.text: The forest remembers footsteps. Yours, now, too.

lines.speaker: SCOUT MIRA
lines.text: You did not burn anything. That was the first test. You keep passing.

lines.speaker: SCOUT MIRA
lines.text: You remember the paths without marking them. The forest sent me to the Reefs for you. It does not send people.

lines.speaker: SCOUT MIRA
lines.text: Something moves under the old grove. The Warden says wait. I'm waiting. Loudly.

lines.speaker: SCOUT MIRA
lines.text: A Nexus captain walked the grove in my prints. Every one. I nearly liked her.

lines.speaker: SCOUT MIRA
lines.text: The cities wear masks. The forest would eat a mask. Slowly. Politely.

lines.speaker: SCOUT MIRA
lines.text: The elder tree knows your companion's name. It said so. Trees don't say things. It said so.

lines.speaker: SCOUT MIRA
lines.text: The forest is growing around the scars. The paths stopped changing. I miss learning them. A little.
